SOL.name: AI Business Automation
SOL.desc: Replace manual, repetitive operations with intelligent workflows that run on their own and hand off to your team only when judgment is needed.

SOL.name: AI Social Media Automation
SOL.desc: Keep every channel active and on-brand with AI that plans, creates and publishes content, so marketing stops depending on someone finding the time.

SOL.name: Custom AI Chatbots and Agents
SOL.desc: Give every visitor an instant, knowledgeable answer at any hour, and let agents qualify leads and support customers while your team focuses on the work only people can do.

SOL.name: AI-Powered Business Dashboards
SOL.desc: One clear view of the whole business: performance, workflows and insight in real time, with reports that write themselves.

SOL.name: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
SOL.desc: Practical AI consultancy and custom implementations that turn your data into forecasts, decisions and new capabilities.

SOL.name: IoT and Smart Technology
SOL.desc: Connect the physical side of your business so equipment, spaces and sensors report, respond and feed the same intelligence as everything else.

ECO.name: AI Business Automation
ECO.text: Runs the repetitive core of the business: lead routing, follow-ups, CRM updates, scheduling and back-office tasks.
ECO.example: Example: when an agent qualifies a lead, automation creates the CRM record, books the call and sends the follow-up.

ECO.name: Social Media Intelligence
ECO.text: Plans, creates and publishes content across platforms, then listens to engagement so the next piece is smarter than the last.
ECO.example: Example: engagement patterns flow to machine learning, which shapes what the content engine produces next.

ECO.name: AI Agents
ECO.text: Answer customers, qualify prospects and take action around the clock, then pass structured results to the rest of the system.
ECO.example: Example: a chat on your website becomes a qualified lead, a scheduled meeting and a line on your dashboard.

ECO.name: Business Dashboards
ECO.text: The command view. Every other system reports here, so you see operations, customers and performance in one place.
ECO.example: Example: one screen shows leads, content performance, workflow health and equipment status together.

ECO.name: Machine Learning
ECO.text: Learns from the data the other systems generate to forecast demand, score leads and flag anything unusual early.
ECO.example: Example: sensor and sales history combine to predict what you will need before you run short.

ECO.name: IoT Infrastructure
ECO.text: Connects physical equipment, spaces and devices so the business can sense what is happening and respond automatically.
ECO.example: Example: a monitored device raises a condition, automation dispatches a task, and the dashboard logs it.

IND.name: E-commerce
IND.lead: Turn browsers into buyers and keep operations lean as order volume grows.
apps: Automation
Abandoned-cart and post-purchase follow-ups that run without manual effort.
Agents
A product-aware shopping assistant that answers questions and guides visitors to the right item.
Machine learning
Demand forecasting to keep inventory balanced.

IND.name: Real Estate
IND.lead: Respond to every inquiry instantly and keep each deal moving.
apps: Agents
Instant lead qualification and showing scheduling, day or night.
Social
Listing content, captions and promotional video produced consistently.
Dashboards
A live pipeline view across listings, leads and follow-ups.

IND.name: Healthcare businesses
IND.lead: Reduce administrative load so staff can spend more time with patients. We focus on non-clinical operations; compliance needs such as HIPAA are scoped together during discovery.
apps: Automation
Appointment reminders, intake workflows and recall campaigns.
Agents
After-hours answers to common practice questions, with clear handoff to staff.
Dashboards
Operational visibility across scheduling, no-shows and capacity.

IND.name: Professional services
IND.lead: Win back billable hours by systemizing the work around the work.
apps: Automation
Client intake, document routing and status updates handled automatically.
Agents
A knowledge-base assistant trained on your firm's own materials.
Dashboards
Clear visibility into pipeline, utilization and deadlines.

IND.name: Restaurants and hospitality
IND.lead: Keep guests engaged and the house running smoothly, even during the rush.
apps: Agents
Reservation and inquiry handling across web and messaging.
Social
Menu, event and promotion content published on a steady rhythm.
IoT
Equipment and environment monitoring that alerts you before problems become closures.

IND.name: Retail
IND.lead: Connect the shop floor, the stockroom and the storefront.
apps: Machine learning
Inventory and demand insight to reduce stock-outs and overstock.
Agents
Customer assistants for product questions and store information.
IoT
Smart sensors for stock levels, foot traffic and store conditions.

IND.name: Marketing agencies
IND.lead: Deliver more for every client without growing headcount at the same rate.
apps: Social
Scale content production across many client accounts and platforms.
Automation
Client reporting that assembles itself on schedule.
Dashboards
A multi-client view of campaigns, deliverables and results.

IND.name: Local service businesses
IND.lead: Never lose a job to a missed call or a slow reply again.
apps: Agents
Missed-call and web inquiries answered and turned into booked appointments.
Automation
Quote follow-ups and review requests sent at the right moment.
Dashboards
Clear visibility of jobs, schedules and revenue pipeline.

WHYS: Built around your workflows and customers, never a one-size-fits-all template.
Every project is tied to a concrete outcome: time saved, leads kept, errors removed.
From the first trigger to the final report, with no gaps for work to fall through.
Start with one system and add others as you grow, on a foundation that holds.
Plain-language guidance from people who learn your business before recommending anything.
We monitor, refine and extend your systems after launch, not just before it.
Automation, agents, analytics and devices that share data instead of living in silos.

STEPS.name: Discover
STEPS.text: Understand the business, its challenges, and automation opportunities.
items: Walk through your daily operations and customer journey
Identify repetitive work and costly bottlenecks
Map the tools and data you already use

STEPS.name: Strategize
STEPS.text: Develop a customized AI implementation strategy.
items: Prioritize opportunities by impact and effort
Define the systems, integrations and success measures
Agree a clear roadmap before any build begins

STEPS.name: Engineer
STEPS.text: Build, integrate, and deploy intelligent solutions.
items: Build and connect the automations, agents and dashboards
Launch and train your team to use it

STEPS.name: Optimize
STEPS.text: Monitor performance, improve workflows, and scale technology.
items: Track how each system performs in daily use
Refine workflows as your business changes
Extend the ecosystem as new needs appear
